title: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
description:
arXiv:2611.25105v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample.
